newsitem.title: UK: UK shares rebound on Wall Street recovery.
newsitem.headline: UK shares rebound on Wall Street recovery.

text.p: The leading FTSE 100 staged a broad-based recovery on Tuesday, inspired by a strong performance on Wall Street ahead of today's Federal Open Market Committee meeting, dealers said.
AT 0837 GMT, the UK blue chip share index was up 30.4 points to 4,245.2, having lost 4.7 percent in the previous six sessions. Gainers were beating decliners 93 to five.
"There's still a hint of caution ahead of the (FOMC) meeting, the long (Easter holiday) weekend and the election," said one dealer.
